## Changes

### Added
- iOS: Yoru now has an iOS app (iOS 15 or newer). Install the `.ipa` below with AltStore, SideStore or Sideloadly. In AltStore or SideStore, add the source `https://yoru.kurodev.org/altstore.json` to get updates; the app also tells you when a new version is out. iOS runs Yoru extensions only, not Mihon extensions, and pauses refreshes and downloads soon after you leave the app. The README's "iOS limits" section lists the rest.
- iOS: DNS over HTTPS (More → DNS over HTTPS) also covers the in-app WebView and extensions on iOS 17 or newer, so sites your network's DNS blocks load there too.
- iOS: Drive sync and the bookmark refresh notification work as on Android.

### Fixed
- Adding a Mihon repo where Mihon extensions can't run (iOS, Android 8 and older) now says why, instead of "Not a valid extension repo URL".
